title: upload_blob response body has no size cap
description: In blob.rs upload_blob(), the server response is read via resp.json().await with no size limit. A hostile or misbehaving server can return an arbitrarily large JSON body, causing unbounded memory allocation and potential OOM. All other methods (fetch_session=1MiB, call=8MiB, download_blob=64MiB) have explicit size caps before reading, but upload_blob skips this pattern entirely. Trigger: blob upload to a server that returns a multi-GB response body.
